document: Kad Pengenalan Kuning (yellow smart identity card)
office: the Jabatan Imigresen dan Pendaftaran Kebangsaan (Immigration and National Registration Department)

routes.label: at the Department's headquarters or a district branch office

note: The Department's page for the smart identity card: the yellow card is issued to Brunei citizens of 12 and over, at its headquarters or district branches; failing to register in time draws a compound fine of up to BND 200 (not modelled). The fee isn't on the page and the guide that quotes it refused this session, so it's null; so are the term and the time.

sources.title: Jabatan Imigresen dan Pendaftaran Kebangsaan (Brunei Darussalam), Kad Pengenalan Pintar
sources.said: Kad Pengenalan Kuning dikeluarkan kepada: Warganegara Brunei Darussalam Telah mencapai umur 12 tahun ke atas. ... boleh dikenakan denda kompaun maksimum tidak lebih dari BND$200.00
